home.heroTitle: Sit with it a moment — then choose
home.heroBody: You don’t need classical names by heart. Bring one honest question: work, someone you care about, or when. Together we’ll draw a time–situation picture you can lean on. The decision stays yours — and we hope you choose with kindness.
home.pillarCalcDesc: Same time, same place — the same picture. That consistency is something you can trust.
home.pillarAi: Suggestions with a place to stand
home.pillarAiDesc: Every claim cites a classical source; when a model is used, we say so clearly.
home.pillarDecideDesc: We offer a frame to think with — never a substitute for your judgment or your heart.
home.systemsBody: Don’t worry about classical names. Pick the doorway that matches what you’re carrying.
home.curiosityTitle: Each picture is a small story
home.curiosityBody: Highlights, bright spots and shadows — revealed in turn. Read slowly and you’ll see time and situation braid together — to live lighter, not to fear more.

home.ctaPricing: When you want to go deeper
home.pain1.title: Trying hard, still circling
home.pain1.body: New place, new method — the old feeling returns, like sending résumés and hearing silence.
home.pain2.title: Standing at a fork
home.pain2.body: Afraid of choosing wrong. You need a quiet picture — not a shout of “do it now.”
home.pain3.title: Fine outside, unsettled inside
home.pain3.body: Wanting to see where you’re stuck — gently, without being judged.
home.diffTitle: How is this different from “tell my fortune” pages?
home.diff.us1: Same time, same place — same picture
home.diff.us3: You stay at the wheel — with kindness
home.packagesBody: Today you only need one gentle try. Go deeper when you’re ready — no pressure to buy.
home.proofTitle: Real words from people will live here
home.proofEmpty: We don’t invent reviews. When someone agrees to share, their story will appear here — honestly.
home.faq1.a: No. It’s a place to lean while you look at a situation more slowly. The picture follows classical rules; suggestions cite sources; decisions — and how you live — stay yours.
home.faq2.q: I know nothing about Qi Men…
home.faq2.a: That’s fine. You only need a datetime and an everyday question. “Quick understanding” uses examples — no memorizing required.
home.faq3.a: A full picture, suggestions, and keeping them on your device. Paid plans go deeper — you’re never forced to buy.
home.faq4.a: We don’t sell it. Pins stay in your browser; when accounts exist, the policy will be clear.
home.faq5.a: Usually under a minute for a picture. Reading suggestions can be as slow as a short letter from a kind friend.

home.step1.title: You bring a question
home.step1.body: For example: should I change jobs this month? Should I speak honestly with them — kindly?
home.step2.title: We draw a picture with you
home.step2.body: Three classical ways of looking — like a compass, a conversation, a season’s rhythm — appear at once. No prior study needed.
home.step3.title: You choose the next step
home.step3.body: No one judges for you. Only suggestions, a place to lean, and quiet space to think — then live more kindly.
